rationale: The agent verified the user correctly using full name + zip and acted only on that user’s account. It updated one order’s address as requested and successfully changed the jigsaw item to an easier variant using the user’s default PayPal, with a correct post-change summary. However, the policy requires the agent to state the exact change and obtain explicit confirmation before any order-changing write. The agent modified the jigsaw item without first presenting the exact replacement (specific variant and price difference) and getting the user’s explicit go-ahead; it executed the change immediately after checking variants. That violates the confirmation requirement. There is also a minor potential issue where the agent stated the order was “pending” without explicit tool evidence shown, though the later successful modification suggests it was indeed modifiable. Not updating the other order’s address or the profile address wasn’t explicitly requested at that point and is not itself a policy failure. The primary failure is performing an order modification without prior explicit confirmation of the exact change.
